create.name: Zen Montañas y Mar
create.bio:
Zen Montañas y Mar is a lay Zen community in Santiago, Chile, practising in the Diamond Sangha stream of the Sanbō Zen lineage that comes down from Harada and Yasutani Rōshi. Its teacher is Daniel Terragno Rōshi, who was born in Santiago, moved to San Francisco in the late 1960s to study economics and spent some twenty years with the teachings of G. I. Gurdjieff before taking up meditation in 1986. Two years later he joined the California Diamond Sangha in Santa Rosa, where he trained with John Tarrant Rōshi, beginning as an apprentice teacher in 1995 and receiving dharma transmission in 2001. He has also volunteered in hospices and taught Zen in prisons.

The sangha meets for zazen on Friday evenings in the Providencia district of Santiago, and newcomers with no experience are welcome after arranging a short introduction by email. Its main retreat is a silent summer sesshin led by Terragno Rōshi at a country retreat house, with sitting and walking meditation, daily talks, private interviews, work practice, chanting and formal oryoki meals. The website keeps a page of the teacher's recorded talks and interviews, including talks given at Latin American Zen gatherings, and an archive of the community's past retreats.

courses.title: Weekly zazen in Providencia
courses.description: Zen sitting every Friday evening at the group's Santiago practice place in Providencia. No previous experience is needed; first-timers write first to arrange a simple introduction.

courses.title: Sesshin de Verano 2027
courses.description: A silent summer Zen retreat at Casa Guangualí led by Daniel Terragno Rōshi, with zazen, walking meditation, daily teisho, private interviews, work practice, sutra chanting and oryoki meals. Shared rooms and vegetarian meals are included; registration is by online form.

free_resources.title: Charlas y teishos
free_resources.description: A page of recorded talks and interviews with Daniel Terragno Rōshi, in Spanish and English, gathered from Zen gatherings in Latin America and elsewhere.
